title: Many agents, and what emerges
sub: The tenth and last film of What an agent is, a series on what an AI agent is and what it isn't: many simple parts can do what none of them planned, in a building that cools itself, an ant colony, a flock, a market and a team of AI agents; so test the group, keep measuring it, and let a person decide.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, violet the model, orange the data and its evidence, green what is checked and agrees, amber a slip or a doubt. The places outside the university are painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and year on a tag.
